== Power Up Requisition ==
[[File:Power Up Requisition.png|thumb|right|upright|420px|Power Up Requisition]]
Bring this requisition form to the Kobold Foreman in a crystal collection challenge to increase the total cap of temporary powerups that can be used on your kobolds from 5 to 10.

* Acquired by:
** {{Verified|Killing boss monsters in any challenge. (~4-5% chance for them to drop a random challenge item)}}, [[Bound to Character]].
** Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear and Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], [[Bound to Account]].

* Usable in the following collection challenges:
'''Extraplanar Palace:'''
* [[Extraplanar Palace: Labor Shortage| Labor Shortage]]
* [[Extraplanar Palace: Labor Shortage - EPIC| Labor Shortage - EPIC]]
